purpose: Safe local contribution and validation of the bounded M1 intent-to-pull-request slice.
implementation_scope: The current bootstrap implements only a subset; this manifest defines the complete M1 Developer Trial envelope.

identity.assumption: A local reference identity provider can issue attributable test identities without becoming the domain contract.
before_m1_tests: Profile declares identity owner, assurance assumptions, and synthetic-user restriction.
m1_exit_tests: Authenticated CLI scope is server-derived and negative identity paths fail closed.
before_trial_tests: Identity issuance, expiry, revocation, and audit tests pass on a clean host.

storage.assumption: Local relational and object storage hold only Developer Trial data and use no production durability claim.
before_m1_tests: Storage ownership, local-volume use, and unsupported durability are explicit.
m1_exit_tests: Capability-owned records do not use cross-capability shared-table writes.
before_trial_tests: Backup, restore, cleanup, and logical-deletion reconciliation tests pass.

repository.assumption: Repository access uses a task-scoped developer credential reference and one configured Forge repository.
before_m1_tests: Repository binding and credential scope have accepted contract tests.
m1_exit_tests: Worker and publication adapter cannot exceed the bound repository and branch.
before_trial_tests: Credential expiry, revocation, ambiguous publication, and cleanup tests pass.

worker_isolation.assumption: A separate local worker process can enforce filesystem, process, network, secret, time, and resource limits.
before_m1_tests: Isolation mechanism and negative test plan are accepted before worker implementation.
m1_exit_tests: Escape, egress, quota, timeout, cancellation, and credential-cleanup tests pass.
before_trial_tests: Isolation suite passes on every declared supported Developer host.

network.assumption: Bootstrap services bind loopback and worker egress is denied unless an exact destination is authorized.
before_m1_tests: Compose loopback and production-shaped rejection checks pass.
m1_exit_tests: Worker and adapter destination allow-lists fail closed.
before_trial_tests: Clean-host egress and DNS/redirect negative tests pass.

secrets.assumption: Static Compose credentials remain development-only; M1 task credentials are short-lived references resolved only in the worker.
before_m1_tests: Development credential markers and secret-reference contracts are checked.
m1_exit_tests: Secrets are absent from prompts, logs, telemetry, evidence, and durable workflow state.
before_trial_tests: Seeded-secret and revocation tests pass across every output channel.

evidence.assumption: Consequential publication blocks unless integrity-verifiable evidence is durably ready.
before_m1_tests: Evidence schema, integrity decision, and unavailable-sink tests are specified.
m1_exit_tests: Mutation and unavailable-sink tests pass for the exact candidate digest.
before_trial_tests: Independent evidence verification and disclosure tests pass.

telemetry.assumption: Developer telemetry is local, payload-minimized, and separate from audit evidence.
before_m1_tests: Debug-exporter status and prohibited payload classes are explicit.
m1_exit_tests: Source, prompts, secrets, and personal data are absent from routine telemetry.
before_trial_tests: Seeded-data, retention, and evidence-promotion tests pass.

backup_restore.assumption: No recovery objective is supported until backup and restore behaviour is validated.
before_m1_tests: Backup scope and restore-reconciliation plan are documented.
m1_exit_tests: Committed delivery state survives worker loss and manual recovery is possible.
before_trial_tests: Backup and restore preserve tenant scope, deletion, and evidence integrity.

upgrade_rollback.assumption: The Developer Trial has no compatibility guarantee until versioned migration and rollback tests exist.
before_m1_tests: Upgrade and rollback ownership, inputs, and failure behaviour are documented.
m1_exit_tests: Candidate changes remain branch-scoped and reversible.
before_trial_tests: Clean upgrade and rollback rehearsals pass without rebuilding accepted artefacts.

capacity_recovery.assumption: The first-slice validation envelope is a hypothesis, not an SLO or support commitment.
before_m1_tests: Capacity, timeout, concurrency, and recovery hypotheses are recorded.
m1_exit_tests: Bounded concurrency, timeout, retry, and manual recovery criteria pass.
before_trial_tests: Measured results are recorded for the declared Developer host envelope.

conformance_tests.expected: Non-developer and unsafe bootstrap configurations fail before side effects.
Profile, schema, Compose, lifecycle, and navigation checks pass.
The complete local verification contract passes from a clean checkout.
The accepted public CLI journey passes for the exact candidate revision.
